verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਸ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਹੁਇ ਅਧਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਹੇਤੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਸੁ ਧਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: nis dhuramat hui adharam karam het gurmat baasur su dharam karam hai ||

en.bdb: A base wisdom is full of ignorance. It encourages sin and evil deeds. The wisdom given by the True Guru is like the brightness of the day that pronounces righteous deeds.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਿਨਕਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਕੇ ਉਦੋਤ ਸਭ ਕਿਛ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਿਸ ਅੰਧਿਆਰੀ ਭੂਲੇ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਭਰਮ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: dhinakar jot ke udhot sabh kichh soojhai nis a(n)dhiaaree bhoole bhramat bharam hai ||

en.bdb: With the emergence of Sun-like teachings of the True Guru, all that would stand in good stead becomes conspicuous. But consider any idol worship as dark night where one keeps wandering in doubts and suspicions by going wayward from the True path.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਦਿਬਿ ਦੇਹ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਹੁਇ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵਕ ਹੁਇ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਚਰਮ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sukh fal dhib dheh dhirasaT hui aan dhev sevak hui dhirasaT charam hai ||

en.bdb: By the virtues of Naam obtained from the True Guru an obedient Sikh becomes capable of seeing all that is not visible openly or conspicuously. Whereas the followers of gods and goddesses remain manifested with evil or sinning vision.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਅੰਧ ਅੰਧ ਕੰਧ ਲਾਗੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੰਧ ਪਰਮਾਰਥ ਮਰਮੁ ਹੈ ॥੪੮੮॥
verses.translit_en: sa(n)saaree sa(n)saaree sa(n)g a(n)dh a(n)dh ka(n)dh laagai gurmukh sa(n)dh paramaarath maram hai ||488||

en.bdb: The worldly people associate with gods in search of worldly pleasures just like a blind person holds onto the shoulder of another in search of the right path. But Sikhs acquire spiritual knowledge and awareness by uniting with the True Guru. (488)
